title: Automated Dashboard
summary: Automate one metric that drives decisions — start manually, then automate.

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** An automated dashboard saves time on data collection — if you know which number is important.
- **Why now?** After four decision-making numbers — one of them is collected automatically.
bullets: **What will you understand?** An automated dashboard saves time on data collection — if you know which number is important.
**Why now?** After four decision-making numbers — one of them is collected automatically.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: Automate Everything — Without Decision
sections.contentMarkdown: - 20 charts — you don't know which number matters. **Manual First** before automation.
bullets: 20 charts — you don't know which number matters. **Manual First** before automation.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: One Number = Success
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Collect manually for two weeks — if you read it and make a decision, automate it.
- **Update Frequency:** Daily, weekly, real-time — based on the decision.

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Understanding Automated Dashboards
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Question:** You have four numbers on the dashboard — what is the best first step for automation?

Automate the metric you read every week and make a decision — after collecting it manually for two weeks.
Automate all four numbers at once before trying manually.
Build 10 additional charts in Looker Studio.

**Explanation:** Start with the one metric you already read weekly and act on — after two manual weeks that prove it matters.
